title: Deltarune Explosion
blurb: Gloriously scuffed, slightly too loud, exactly as dramatic as it is ridiculous. Toby Fox's explosion sound demonstrates his whole approach to audio: it does not attempt realism, it attempts effect, and it lands somewhere between a real detonation and a cartoon one. Fans know it from the chapters' more chaotic moments. Everyone else simply hears a perfect comedy blast. Use it when something detonates narratively rather than physically, like a secret revealed, an argument comprehensively destroyed, or the group chat at three in the morning.
origin: The explosion sound from Deltarune (Toby Fox).
